tags.adversarial-training: Trains a generator against a critic; task-owned auxiliary objectives may also apply.
tags.critic-gradient-penalty: Uses a penalty on critic input gradients; its formula and strength are configuration-specific.
tags.capped-input-gradients: Penalizes critic input-gradient norms above a threshold on real and generated inputs; this is a soft loss penalty.
tags.native-adam: Uses native Adam without formulation-specific optimizer interventions.
tags.constant-learning-rate: Declared baseline uses constant learning rates; resolved per-role rates remain configuration-specific.
tags.selectable-loss: The family explicitly supports multiple adversarial loss formulations.
tags.optimizer-interventions: Includes formulation-specific interventions around optimizer steps; availability depends on the host and resolved recipe.
tags.adaptive-training-policy: Uses an observation-driven training policy rather than a fixed update schedule.
tags.structural-ablation: Removes a named mechanism from a parent technique and retains a separate evidence identity.
tags.historical-cohort: A retained historical family with its original source, prior and scoring contracts.
tags.learning-rate-annealing: Declared baseline decreases learning rates during training; horizons and floors are configuration-specific.
